input_manifest.transform: Native central differences for omega*D/U, then every second point of a fluid-only rectangular wake ROI. No filtering or interpolation.
input_manifest.spatial_scope: Wake ROI, x/D=1..13.833, y/D=-2.625..2.542, D=12 native lattice cells; not full-domain/wall CFD.

forecast_protocol.rollout: Initialize only at frame159; advance autonomously through validation AND test without resetting.

input_manifest.status: New teaching experiments on previously inspected CFD; no new blind research claim. Source remains coarse educational LBM, not grid-independent CFD.
